doubts: Tauranga Bay car park has no road-end feature; I gave T4 (the Tauranga Bay coast name) as the start because the text says to start at Tauranga Bay, but the car park point may differ from the bay's point. The walkway can be walked from either end; Cape Foulwind car park (F1, where a track meets Lighthouse Road) is the main way's end and also listed as the other start. W3 is stated as Tauranga Bay to the lighthouse (2 hr / 5.8 km return), but the text also offers continuing 15 min to Cape Foulwind car park and being picked up or returning via the Kawatiri Coastal Trail. The time and distance for W2/W3 are split from the lines '30 min / 1 km (return)' and '2 hr / 5.8 km (return)'.
